items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 99:1
items.html: (To the question) At the time of the slumber, meaning the ascent of the MAN of ZON to Aba and Ima, who are in the place of AB, there Aba is entirely MAH, namely his Hochma and Hassadim, and those of Ima. And Ima is entirely BAN, namely her Binot and Gevurot, and those of Aba. And it is found that ZA, who is included there in Aba, is also entirely MAH, namely the Hochma and Hassadim of Aba and Ima, as well as the right half of the upper and lower Daat, which also belongs to MAH. And the Nukva, who is included there in Ima, is entirely BAN, like Ima, namely the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, as well as the left side of the upper and lower Daat, which are also counted as BAN. And the Binot and Gevurot that the Nukva takes are counted immediately, as they clothe in her, namely in the aspect of Leah, who borrows the vessels of Rachel, as above in Answer 222, see there. But ZA, who does not descend from there except at the time of the shofar blast, as said there — it is found that the Mochin of Hochma and Hassadim and half the upper Daat and the lower Daat, which he takes there from Aba, are for him only in the aspect of Makifim; for as long as ZA is in Aba, the Mochin are discerned only as Makifim for the aspect of his VAK, which remained in slumber below, as said below in Answer 254, see there. (Items 160 and 161).
